key.name: show-cpu
key.description: Show the CPU monitor chip in the top bar.

key.name: show-ram
key.description: Show the RAM monitor chip in the top bar.

key.name: show-gpu
key.description: Show the GPU monitor chip in the top bar.

key.name: show-disk
key.description: Show the Disk/Storage monitor chip in the top bar.

key.name: show-sys
key.description: Show the system thermals chip in the top bar.

key.name: show-net
key.description: Show the network monitor chip in the top bar.

key.name: use-icons
key.summary: Use icons instead of text labels
key.description: When enabled, chips show symbolic icons instead of text abbreviations (CPU, RAM, etc.).

key.name: blur-sigma
key.description: Gaussian blur radius for the glass effect on dropdown panels. 0 disables blur.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of dropdown panels. Lower values are more transparent/glassy.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to refresh the panel indicators, in milliseconds.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which panel box to place the indicator in: left, center, or right.
